experiment: E1 zoom (scale) sensitivity of published detectors (docs/04-phase4-plan.md Amendment 7); exploratory diagnostic, not a hypothesis, not counted toward the stop rule
bootstrap: paired cluster bootstrap: reals by device, fakes by image stratified per generator (lib/metrics.bootstrap_weights); one plan per real pool shared by both arms and all detectors
condition_call: perturb.apply_condition(img, cond, key=sha256, seed=0), identical for both classes

detectors.b0: 005 arm A0 (DINOv2-base primary features, class-balanced logistic probe, StratifiedGroupKFold), LOGO over 6 generators

rows_scored_pretrained: split in (calib, test), both arms; orig-arm scores reused from experiments/007-worst-env-conformal/pilot/scores_pretrained.csv.gz after a 32-image GPU re-score check
test: 358 reals per pool (VISION native / WA / FBH; 25 devices) and 60 fakes x 6 generators
thresholds: 1%-FPR threshold = lib/metrics.threshold_for_fpr(calib natives, 0.01) (43 reals -> the calib max + eps); sensitivity variant with all 129 calib reals
primary: delta = AUROC(orig) - AUROC(fov512), macro over 6 generators vs test natives; scale-sensitive iff |delta| >= 0.03 and the 95% CI excludes 0
texture: mean |4-neighbour Laplacian| of the grayscale (mean of RGB, /255) of each detector's actual model input before normalisation (CommFor Resize440+Crop384, RINE Crop224, ClipDet Resize224bicubic+Crop224, B0 Crop224), after the condition; direction (sign) chosen per (input, arm, condition) on TRAIN natives vs train fakes (calib has reals only)

d008.device: cuda vs cpu(batch 4); applies to every new scoring run (fov512 arm); orig arm = re-score check vs 007 stored scores
